patch_description: The proposed ansatz evolves the high-performing mirror-symmetric structure of the seed programs by incorporating a diverse mixed-axis controlled-rotation core. Key parameters are the mirrord single-qubit rotations (RY for input lifting and RZ for output phase refinement) which utilize parameter sharing to keep the model efficient. The entanglement layer is enhanced by combining fixed long-range CZ gates with parameterized mixed-axis couplings: shared long-range CRZ gates for global coordination and shared local CRX/CRY gates for neighborhood interactions. This configuration maintains the parameter efficiency of the original 74-parameter model (12 parameters per block) while increasing the expressivity of the entanglement layer to improve test accuracy and convergence speed.
